title: Cochin Shipyard order book rises to ₹219 billion
desc: Cochin Shipyard's order book grew to ₹219 billion, up from ₹211 billion as on June 30, reflecting continued momentum in shipbuilding contracts.

title: Swish raises $24 million to expand food delivery ops
desc: Swish has raised $24 million to expand its food delivery business to 100+ cities and build 1,000 cloud kitchens, intensifying competition with Eternal and Swiggy.

title: Cochin Shipyard Q1FY27 Results: Revenue up, profit falls
desc: Cochin Shipyard Ltd reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹1,094 crore, up 23% YoY. Net profit fell 2% to ₹151 crore as EBITDA margins contracted to 24%. Order book stands at ₹20,700 crore.

title: Supreme Infra cuts guarantee exposure by 80%
desc: Supreme Infrastructure India Ltd reduces corporate guarantee exposure from ₹180 crore to ₹36.51 crore via resolution plan for erstwhile subsidiary Kopargaon Ahmednagar Tollways.

title: Dilip Buildcon sells 51% stake in power transmission SPV
desc: Dilip Buildcon has executed agreements to divest its 51% stake in Mekhali Power Transmission Limited to Alpha Alternatives. The transaction, valued at an enterprise value of approximately ₹2,914 crore, supports the company's asset-light strategy.

title: Techknowgreen Solutions wins Rs 81.45 lakh order from Mahindra & Mahindra
desc: Techknowgreen Solutions secures Rs 81.45 lakh work order from Mahindra & Mahindra Limited for environmental clearance services for a Greenfield project in Nagpur. The order adds to a Q2FY27 inflow of Rs 7.38 crore.

title: Mukka Proteins approves ₹47 cr convertible warrants
desc: Mukka Proteins Ltd approved preferential allotment of 2 crore convertible warrants at ₹23.50 each, raising ₹47 crore from 15 non-promoter investors. Warrants are convertible within 18 months.

title: Tuticorin Alkali unveils new brand identity
desc: Tuticorin Alkali Chemicals & Fertilizers Ltd launches new logo reflecting sustainable manufacturing and global growth, marking a milestone in its evolution.

title: MobiKwik expands FX Retail to six currencies
desc: One MobiKwik Systems Ltd expands its FX Retail service to include five new currencies alongside USD. The move, launched at GFF 2026, makes it the sole private player offering multi-currency forex via NPCI partnership.

title: Ceat expects Camso performance to improve in FY28
desc: Ceat's Co CFO projects better results for Camso in FY28 compared to FY27, citing improved customer servicing. The US market remains a lower priority due to profitability concerns.

title: Prestige Estates incorporates two new real estate subsidiaries
desc: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd has incorporated Southgrove Homes LLP and Parkgrove Realty LLP as wholly-owned subsidiaries on September 9, 2026. Both entities will focus on real estate development with initial capital contributions of ₹1 lakh each.

title: Ramco Cements Wins Global Biodiversity Certification
desc: Ramco Cements' Pandalgudi mine restoration earns Advanced Certification from The Global Biodiversity Standard, becoming the first site in Peninsular India to receive this recognition.

title: Unipro Technologies to hold 41st AGM on Sep 30
desc: Unipro Technologies schedules its 41st AGM for September 30, 2026, via VC/OAVM. Key agenda items include adopting FY26 financials and appointing a new secretarial auditor for five years.

title: Anawil Wire wins order worth ₹141 crore
desc: Anawil Wire & Engineering has secured a new order worth ₹141 crore. The company's market capitalisation stands at ₹1,000 crore.

title: Signet Industries promoter Mukesh Sangla buys 7642 shares
desc: Mukesh Sangla, a promoter of Signet Industries, acquired 7642 equity shares from the open market on September 8, 2026. His stake rose to 4.64%.

title: G Visalatchi boosts stake in RPP Infra to 12.17%
desc: G Visalatchi and PACs increased their holding in RPP Infra Projects from 8.59% to 12.17% via open market purchases. The acquisition of 1,777,340 shares was disclosed under SEBI regulations on September 9, 2026.

title: GR Infra maintains 15-20% revenue growth forecast
desc: GR Infra reaffirms its revenue growth guidance of 15% to 20% for the current fiscal year. The company also projects a standalone margin of 10% to 11% for FY27, signaling stable operational expectations.

title: GR Infra anticipates ₹20,000 crore orders in FY27
desc: GR Infraprojects anticipates receiving orders worth ₹20,000 crore in FY27, signalling a strong pipeline for the infrastructure company in the coming fiscal year.

title: Nureca promoter Saurabh Goyal buys 1.46% stake
desc: Nureca Ltd promoter Saurabh Goyal acquired 1,39,656 shares on market between July 29 and September 9, 2026. His holding rose to 69.55% from 68.09%. No encumbrances reported.

title: Nureca promoter Smita Goyal acquires 0.60% stake
desc: Smita Goyal, a member of the promoter group of Nureca Limited, acquired 57,337 equity shares on market between July 24 and September 9, 2026. This acquisition increased her total holding to 57,344 shares, representing a 0.60% stake in the company.

title: Indoco Remedies promoters buy 38,930 shares
desc: Promoters of Indoco Remedies acquired 38,930 equity shares in the open market on September 8 and 9, 2026. The group's stake rose to 7.30% with no encumbrances reported.

title: Gandhar Oil promoter acquires 31,000 shares
desc: Promoter Ramesh Babulal Parekh acquired 31,000 equity shares of Gandhar Oil Refinery via open market on Sep 8, 2026. His stake rose to 28.79% from 28.76%. No encumbrances reported.

title: Gandhar Oil Refinery promoter buys 19,000 shares
desc: A promoter of Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) acquired 19,000 shares of the company on September 7, signalling continued insider confidence in the stock.

title: Gujjubhai Industries promoters acquire stake via preferential allotment
desc: Promoter group of Gujjubhai Industries Ltd acquires 1,96,701 equity shares via preferential allotment. Holding rises to 36.50% post-transaction.

title: Shree Hari Chemicals promoters transfer 56,595 shares
desc: Shree Hari Chemicals Export Ltd promoters will transfer 56,595 equity shares at ₹236 each on September 18, 2026. The deal involves three acquirers and three sellers, representing a 0.90% stake change.

title: Counter Cyclical Investments crosses 10% stake in DHP India
desc: Counter Cyclical Investments Private Limited acquired 6,506 shares of DHP India Ltd on September 8, 2026, pushing its total holding to 304,601 shares or 10.15% of the equity capital via open market purchases.

title: Steelcast to host SBI MF investor meet on Sep 16
desc: Steelcast Ltd will hold a virtual one-on-one meeting with SBI Mutual Fund officials on September 16, 2026, at 4:00 pm. The interaction is scheduled under SEBI LODR regulations.

title: Aster DM Quality Care pledge rises 0.57% to 10.33%
desc: Catalyst Trusteeship Limited disclosed a net increase in pledged shares of Aster DM Quality Care. The encumbrance rose by 49,96,797 shares, driven by new security for a USD 50 million loan facility.

title: Birlanu plans ₹500 crore capex to expand capacity
desc: Birlanu plans to invest ₹500 crore in capital expenditure over two years to expand its construction chemicals and pipes capacity, according to a newspaper report.

title: Uflex Asepto eyes 100% capacity by 2030 via Egypt plant
desc: Uflex's Asepto division is expanding globally with a new plant in Egypt, targeting 100% capacity utilisation by 2030, according to a newspaper report.

title: India 10-year bond yield rises to 6.97%
desc: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield moved up to 6.9698% from the previous close of 6.9568%, reflecting a marginal rise in borrowing costs.

title: Cement majors plan ₹13,000 crore green-power push
desc: UltraTech Cement, Ambuja Cement, and Dalmia Bharat are planning a ₹13,000 crore investment in green energy to cut energy costs and boost margins by up to 160 bps.

title: Indian rupee opens weaker at 95.25 vs dollar
desc: The Indian rupee opened at 95.25 against the US dollar, weaker than its previous close of 95.1050, reflecting a marginal depreciation in the domestic currency.

title: SBI Mutual Fund boosts stake in EID Parry to 9.14%
desc: SBI Mutual Fund acquired 78,142 shares of EID Parry India Ltd on September 8, 2026, raising its stake to 9.1363% via open market purchases under SEBI regulations.

title: KAMA Realty to acquire 1.08% stake in SRF Ltd
desc: KAMA Realty (Delhi) Limited plans to acquire up to 32,00,000 equity shares of SRF Limited from KAMA Holdings via inter-se transfer. The deal aims to create self-sustainable profitability without changing control.

title: Thakkers Group promoter gift of 16.58% stake
desc: Thakkers Group Ltd promoter group proposes acquiring 16.58% equity via gift from Jitendra Thakker to immediate relatives, exempt under SEBI regulations.

title: Signet Industries promoter Mukesh Sangla buys 20,841 shares
desc: Promoter Mukesh Sangla acquired 20,841 equity shares of Signet Industries Ltd from the open market on September 8, 2026. His total holding rose to 4.71% with no encumbrances.

title: Alacrity Securities promoter exits via gift transfer
desc: Promoter Hiten Ramniklal Mehta disposed of 1.74% stake in Alacrity Securities Ltd through an off-market gift transfer on September 8, 2026, reducing his holding to zero.

title: Promoter Harsh Kilachand buys 582 shares in Kesar Terminals
desc: Promoter Harsh Rajnikant Kilachand acquired 582 shares of Kesar Terminals & Infrastructure on September 7, 2026, raising his stake from 9.44% to 9.45% via open market purchase.

title: Kolte Patil Vyana launch hits ₹600cr in 60 hours
desc: Kolte Patil Developers reports record sales of over ₹600 crore within 60 hours for its Vyana at The Reserve project in Pune, marking its strongest-ever launch performance with over 600 apartments booked.

title: Juniper Green Energy completes 75 MW hybrid project
desc: Juniper Green Energy has completed a 75 MW wind-solar hybrid power project, taking its total operational capacity to ~2,604 MWp and ~500 MWh BESS.

title: Sigma Advanced Systems starts Sri City aerospace production
desc: Sigma Advanced Systems begins production at its Sri City facility, offering 100,000 annual machining hours. The 75,000 sq ft plant aims to replicate UK capabilities and scale to 300,000 hours.

title: Coal India, Enviro Infra lead market focus today
desc: Coal India surges on production data; Enviro Infra rallies on Tata Power order. Dilip Buildcon bags ₹1,800cr LOI. Check full briefing.

title: Jonjua Overseas to consider fundraising, rights issue
desc: Jonjua Overseas Ltd schedules board meeting for September 18, 2026. Agenda includes fundraising proposal and subscription to HSJONJUA INNOVATEAGRO Private Limited rights issue.

title: Slone Infosystems wins Rs 6.4 crore order from Transline Technologies
desc: Slone Infosystems secures a confirmed Rs 6.4 crore PO from Transline Technologies for supplying 1000 Lenovo laptops. This is the first disclosed order in the last 3 quarters, providing initial visibility into order inflow against a backdrop of zero TTM revenue.

title: Hindustan Zinc deploys 30 electric trucks for mine logistics
desc: Hindustan Zinc deploys 30 new electric trucks to accelerate mine-to-smelter decarbonisation and signs a 6-year contract with MFL for concentrate transportation from Rampura Agucha Mine.

title: Hazoor Multi Projects wins ₹41.98 crore NHAI order
desc: Hazoor Multi Projects secured a ₹41.98 crore Letter of Award from NHAI for user fee collection at H. Pudhupatti fee plaza in Tamil Nadu. The contract is for one year and adds to the company's growing order book.

title: Skytech Infinite Platform wins Rs 1.25 crore order from Mtar Technologies
desc: Company secures confirmed work order for PLC design and supply. SME player with zero TTM revenue; order marks first disclosed win in recent quarters. Watch execution and revenue recognition.

title: Jyoti Global Plast wins Rs 8.63 crore order from Paras Defence
desc: SME firm secures confirmed work order for precision components in defence imaging systems. First disclosed order inflow. Book-to-bill context unavailable due to zero TTM revenue.

title: Dhara Rail Projects bags Rs 3.66 crore LMG order
desc: Dhara Rail Projects wins a Rs 3.65 crore contract for LHB coach modifications from Lumding Division. The deal adds to its Q2FY27 inflow, which now stands at Rs 27.44 crore.

title: Sarthak Metals CFO Narendra Dewangan passes away
desc: Sarthak Metals Limited announced the demise of its Chief Financial Officer, Narendra Dewangan, on September 9, 2026. Dewangan served as CFO after previously leading accounts for the Desraj Bansal Group.

title: Arihant Foundations AGM set for Sep 30, 2026
desc: Arihant Foundations & Housing Limited will hold its 33rd Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. The meeting will be conducted via video conferencing, with remote e-voting available from September 26 to 29.

title: Shalimar Paints AGM: All 5 Resolutions Pass
desc: Shalimar Paints shareholders approved all five resolutions at the 124th AGM, including adopting FY26 financials and reappointing director Aaditya Sharda. Voting participation stood at 75.9%.

title: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds files FY26 BRSR report
desc: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Limited submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY26 to NSE and BSE. The filing highlights 15% R&D investment, zero safety incidents, and a 10.9% employee turnover rate.

title: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds sets AGM for Sep 30
desc: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Ltd approved its FY26 Board's report and AGM notice. The 12th AGM is scheduled for September 30, 2026, with e-voting from September 27 to 29.

title: Vedant Fashions wins GST appeal, avoids ₹2.73 lakh penalty
desc: Vedant Fashions Ltd received a favourable GST appellate order setting aside penalties of ₹2.73 lakh and interest demand. The ruling resolves an audit issue from FY18-20 with no material financial impact.

title: Focus Lighting wins Rs 13.5 crore L&T order
desc: Focus Lighting & Fixtures secured a Rs 13.5 crore order from Larsen & Toubro for street lighting poles in Northern India. The contract supports infrastructure illumination projects.

title: Gpt Infraprojects wins Rs 114.82 cr NFR order
desc: Gpt Infraprojects secured a Rs 114.82 crore order from Northeast Frontier Railway for electronic interlocking works at ten stations on the Katihar Division route.

title: Ind-Agiv Commerce website down, financials on BSE
desc: Ind-Agiv Commerce Ltd reports technical issues causing its website to go offline. The company has uploaded March 2026 financials and AGM notice to the BSE portal as a compliance measure.

title: Tata Motors sends NCLT scheme notices
desc: Tata Motors Limited has issued notices to shareholders and creditors regarding the NCLT-approved amalgamation of TMF Holdings and TMF Business Services.

title: GE Vernova T&D declares ₹10 dividend at AGM
desc: GE Vernova T&D India held its 70th AGM on September 9, 2026, declaring a ₹10 per share dividend for FY26. Shareholders approved key board appointments and related-party transactions.

title: Capri Global Capital prices $300m notes
desc: Capri Global Capital Ltd has uploaded the final supplemental offering circular for its U.S.$ 300 million senior secured notes due December 2029. The 7.55% coupon notes were issued under its U.S.$ 1 billion GMTN programme.

title: Hexaware Technologies seeks approval for new RSU plan and ESOP amendments
desc: Hexaware Technologies initiates postal ballot for shareholders to approve a new 2 million RSU plan, expand ESOP pool to 41.8 million, and amend CEO incentive terms.

title: Railtel appoints statutory auditors for FY27
desc: Railtel Corporation of India has appointed four chartered accountant firms as statutory auditors for FY27, covering consolidation and regional operations across the country.

title: Krsnaa Diagnostics faces ₹62.69 Cr tax demand
desc: Krsnaa Diagnostics received income tax appellate orders for AY 2017-18 to 2023-24. The aggregate disputed demand stands at ₹62.69 crore. The company plans to appeal to the ITAT.

title: IndiGrid NCD face value rises to ₹1 lakh
desc: IndiGrid Infrastructure Trust revised the paid-up value of Series AI and AJ NCDs to ₹1,00,000 each after receiving ₹880 crore in second pay-in amounts on September 8, 2026.

title: Dixon Technologies to attend Morgan Stanley seminar on Sep 16
desc: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has intimated participation in the MS Virtual India Industrials & Energy Seminar on September 16, 2026. The virtual group session is scheduled for 11:00 am.

title: IndusInd Bank gets ESG rating of 68 from ESGRI
desc: IndusInd Bank disclosed an independent ESG rating of 68 assigned by ESGRI on September 9, 2026. The bank clarified it did not engage the agency, which based the score on public data.

title: SBI Life reappoints joint statutory auditors for FY27
desc: SBI Life Insurance has reappointed M/s. K S Aiyar & Co. and M/s. J Singh & Associates as its Joint Statutory Auditors for the financial year 2026-27, following approval from the C&AG.

title: Engineers India appoints SCV & Co as statutory auditor
desc: Engineers India Limited has appointed M/s S C V & CO LLP as its statutory auditors for FY27. The Comptroller & Auditor General of India (CAG) made the appointment vide letter dated September 8, 2026.

title: Bank of Baroda accepts Sumit Sachdeva's resignation
desc: Bank of Baroda accepted the resignation of Sumit Sachdeva, Head of Large Corporate Relationships, effective September 9, 2026. He cited personal and professional aspirations for his departure.

title: Dixon Technologies meets Baillie Gifford
desc: Dixon Technologies held an in-person one-on-one meeting with Baillie Gifford on September 9, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared.

title: GMR Airports to host investors at Jefferies Forum
desc: GMR Airports Limited will hold one-on-one and group meetings with institutional investors at the 2026 Jefferies India Forum in Gurugram on September 17-18, 2026.

title: IndiaMART holds investor meet with DT Partners
desc: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited disclosed a one-to-one meeting with DT Partners on September 9, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared during the physical session in Noida.

title: PB Fintech allots 57,885 shares under ESOP 2021
desc: PB Fintech has allotted 57,885 shares under its ESOP 2021 scheme, raising the company's paid-up capital to ₹92.55 crore following the allotment.

title: Indoworth Holdings AGM set for Sep 30, 2026
desc: Indoworth Holdings Limited has scheduled its 40th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The event will feature remote e-voting via NSDL for shareholders of record as of September 23.

title: GMR Airports Allots ₹1,500 Cr NCBs at 9.56%
desc: GMR Airports Limited has allotted ₹1,500 crore worth of non-convertible bonds at a 9.56% interest rate. The issuance aims to refinance existing debt carrying a higher 10.75% coupon.

title: Asian Paints appoints Dani as director
desc: Asian Paints shareholders approved the appointment of Ms. Shubhlakshmi Dani as Non-Executive Director via postal ballot. Promoters voted 100% in favor, while public institutions showed some dissent.

title: GOCL Corp AGM on Sep 29, 2026
desc: GOCL Corporation schedules its 65th AGM for September 29, 2026. Shareholders can access the FY25-26 Annual Report via the company website or KFinTech portal.

title: Capacite Infraprojects appoints four CEOs
desc: Capacite Infraprojects Ltd has appointed Amit Govil, Rakesh Kumar Singh, Vishnudas Shanbhag, and Ram Mohan Rai as Chief Executive Officers for its four business units effective September 9, 2026.

title: Shiva Granito Export sets AGM record date
desc: Shiva Granito Export Limited has announced the record date for its 11th Annual General Meeting. Shareholders must hold shares as of September 23, 2026, to vote.

title: Hamps Bio Board Approves Remuneration Hike for Directors
desc: Hamps Bio Limited's board approved remuneration increases for CMD Herrik Mountbaton Shah, WTD Shrenikkumar Mountkumar Shah, CFO Mitali Shah, and Director Pallavi Shah on September 9, 2026.

title: Umiya Tubes schedules 13th AGM for September 30
desc: Umiya Tubes Limited has scheduled its 13th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026, to be held via video conference. Remote e-voting will open on September 27.

title: Gabriel India to host investor meet on Sep 15
desc: Gabriel India Limited will hold a non-deal roadshow with Ambit Capital in Mumbai on September 15, 2026, at 10:00 am. The meeting aims to discuss publicly available information with institutional investors.

title: NHPC Ltd assigned independent ESG score of 48
desc: NHPC Limited disclosed an ESG score of 48 assigned by ESG Risk Assessments & Insights Limited. The rating was prepared independently using public data, not through direct engagement with the company.

title: Accretion Nutraveda seeks ₹500 crore borrowing limit
desc: Accretion Nutraveda Limited seeks shareholder approval for a postal ballot to increase borrowing limits to ₹500 crore and alter its MOA. E-voting runs from September 10 to October 9, 2026.

title: Naturo Agrotech fixes 10th AGM, director appointments
desc: Naturo Agrotech India Limited has fixed its 10th AGM for September 30, 2026. The board recommended regularizing two directors and appointed a secretarial auditor for five years.

title: Neetu Yoshi FY26 Results: PAT up 52% to ₹25.01 crore
desc: Neetu Yoshi Limited reported a 52% YoY rise in profit after tax to ₹25.01 crore for FY26, driven by 43% revenue growth to ₹101.59 crore. The company expanded into coach and track segments, securing an order book of over ₹160 crore.

title: Lords Mark Industries to host investor meet on Sep 10
desc: Lords Mark Industries Limited has been invited by Financial Mindss to participate in an investor summit on September 10, 2026. The virtual session will discuss the company's business progress and operational updates.

title: Wakefit AGM results: Resolutions pass with 99% support
desc: Wakefit Innovations shareholders approved all three resolutions at its 10th AGM on September 9, 2026. Promoters voted in full favor, while public institutions showed slight dissent on financials.

title: Artemis Ebix files FY26 BRSR report
desc: Artemis Ebix Limited has submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY26. The filing details the company's standalone ESG disclosures, including a turnover of ₹716 lakh and net worth of ₹29,187.2 lakh.

title: Abans Enterprises AGM: FY26 results adopted
desc: Abans Enterprises Limited concluded its 40th AGM on September 9, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of audited financial statements for FY26 and the re-appointment of Jinesh Savla as director.

title: Aditya Infotech wins ITAT tax case
desc: Aditya Infotech receives favorable order from Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, deleting entire ₹40.38 crore addition for AY 2019-20. The company will now apply for effect to the order.

title: Canara HSBC Life reappoints two independent directors
desc: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Ltd has reappointed Dr Kishore Kumar Sansi and Mr Supratim Bandyopadhyay as independent directors for three-year terms. The board approved the moves on September 9, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

title: Data Patterns Independent Director Steps Down
desc: Mr. Sastry Venkata Rama Vadlamani ceases tenure as Independent Director at Data Patterns (India) Ltd effective September 9, 2026, citing other commitments.

title: Wakefit AGM: FY26 revenue hits record ₹1,488.9 crore
desc: Wakefit Innovations held its 10th AGM on September 9, 2026, reporting record FY26 operating revenue of ₹1,488.9 crore and PAT of ₹91.1 crore. The company expanded its store count to 139 outlets.

title: NCLT admits Digjam Ltd scheme petition
desc: The NCLT Chennai bench admitted the scheme of arrangement petition between Digjam Limited and Reid & Taylor International Private Limited. The next hearing is scheduled for October 28, 2026.

title: Indrayani Biotech Rights Issue Details
desc: Indrayani Biotech Ltd files Letter of Offer for a ₹4,878.88 lakh rights issue of 3.25 crore partly paid shares at ₹15 each on a 5:7 basis.

title: Madhusudan Industries re-appoints Daarrpan Shah as independent director
desc: Madhusudan Industries Ltd shareholders approved the re-appointment of Daarrpan Shah as an independent director for a second five-year term starting December 30, 2026, during its AGM held on September 9, 2026.
